cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
project(ego_ganyu_bridge)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
find_package(ament_cmake REQUIRED)
foreach(dep rclcpp std_msgs geometry_msgs uav_common_msg traj_utils quadrotor_msgs)
  find_package(${dep} REQUIRED)
endforeach()
add_executable(ego_ganyu_bridge src/bridge.cpp)
if(EGO_BACKEND_V2)
  target_compile_definitions(ego_ganyu_bridge PRIVATE EGO_BACKEND_V2)
endif()
ament_target_dependencies(ego_ganyu_bridge rclcpp std_msgs geometry_msgs uav_common_msg traj_utils quadrotor_msgs)
install(TARGETS ego_ganyu_bridge DESTINATION lib/${PROJECT_NAME})
ament_package()
